QUESTION
For C1, what are the pass fractions among evaluated cohort cases and among all authorized cohort cases? Explain why neither denominator is the original fourteen-file inventory.

EVIDENCE
STATUS
At the Day 12 cutoff, C1 remains selected and does not pass validation: nine passes, two observed failures (A8, B3), and one untested case (B4). Acceptance requires all twelve authorized cases evaluated for the exact candidate version and at least eleven passes. Even a B4 pass would leave C1 below threshold.

EVIDENCE
J01–J02 establish fourteen registered files, with unreadable X1/X2 excluded before outcome inspection, leaving twelve eligible cases. J04–J05 record C1: A1–A7 pass, A8 fails; B1/B2 pass, B3 fails, B4 untested after the machine slot ended. C1's descriptive fractions are 9/11 evaluated cases (81.8%) and 9/12 cohort cases (75%); B4 is not a failure. J06's 9/9 export includes successful examples only and hides failures and missing evaluation. J07–J08 record C2's changed routine and sole evaluation: B3 passes on Day 8. That outcome cannot replace C1's B3 failure. No A8 repair result exists. J10–J12 confirm no further runs or changed rules.

NEXT
Obtain a machine slot to evaluate C1 B4 for completeness, without expecting acceptance. If C2 is selected, evaluate its eleven missing cases: A1–A8, B1, B2, B4. Earlier C1 outcomes cannot transfer; X1/X2 exclusions still apply. Recover J01–J02 for rules, J04–J08 for case/version provenance, and J10–J12 for cutoff state.
